title: Best OP Auto Farm Kill Aura Auto Train Give Wen Max Stats
features:
Ronix Hub - Slayers 2

Combat
- Auto attack with a range and interval you set
- Kill aura with its own range
- Attack the nearest enemy on demand

Farm
- Auto farm enemies with a farm range you control
- Pick the enemy type: All, Bandit, Zuko, Gyutai, Datai, Saneri, Serpent Trainee, Reaper
- Boss only mode
- Teleport to the nearest enemy

Training
- Auto training at the facility you choose
- Train now button

Give
- Auto give Wen, Level, Stat Points, Mastery, and Items
- Set the amount for each, pick the weapon for mastery
- Give any of them right now with one button

Set
- Auto set Health, Reputation, Race, and Clan
- Choose the race and clan you want
- Set any of them right now

Balancer
- Auto balance Stat Points and Mastery
- Auto give the Breathing style you pick

Movement
- Custom WalkSpeed and JumpPower with a reset
- Teleport to an enemy or a player
- Noclip

Quests
- Auto complete quests, or complete now
- Respawn, Max Stats All, and Max Wen buttons

Performance
- Kill particles, no shadows, flat materials, no textures
- Hide players, hide enemies
- FOV slider

Stats
- Player info and session stats

Settings
- Auto save, save and load your config, stop the script
